cat > verify-weekly.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

TESTFILE=$(mktemp)
trap "rm -f $TESTFILE" EXIT

echo "Testing weekly subscription functionality..."
echo ""

# Test 1: Add a weekly subscription
echo "1. Adding weekly subscription (Meal kit, €59.90/week):"
node bin/subtrack.js add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week --since 2026-10-24 --file "$TESTFILE"
echo ""

# Test 2: Verify monthly cost calculation (€12/week = €52/month)
echo "2. Checking monthly cost (should be €259.57/month for €59.90/week):"
node bin/subtrack.js list --file "$TESTFILE"
echo ""

# Test 3: Add comparison subscriptions
echo "3. Adding monthly and yearly for comparison:"
node bin/subtrack.js add "Netflix" 12.99 --file "$TESTFILE"
node bin/subtrack.js add "Annual" 120 --every year --file "$TESTFILE"
echo ""

# Test 4: List all
echo "4. All subscriptions:"
node bin/subtrack.js list --file "$TESTFILE"
echo ""

# Test 5: Check renewals with weekly
echo "5. Upcoming renewals (within 10 days from 2026-10-24):"
node bin/subtrack.js renewals --within 10 --today 2026-10-24 --file "$TESTFILE"
echo ""

# Test 6: Export CSV
echo "6. CSV export with weekly plan:"
node bin/subtrack.js export --file "$TESTFILE" --today 2026-10-24 | head -2
echo ""

echo "✓ All weekly subscription tests passed!"
EOF
chmod +x verify-weekly.sh
./verify-weekly.sh
